_note: Raw DOM measurements taken with Playwright against a live public Gamma deck. Not from marketing copy.
note_on_access: gamma.app/docs/<slug> serves an empty SPA shell to an automated browser (403 on every _next chunk, 50 console errors, 3 DIVs, no __NEXT_DATA__). The /embed/<slug> route renders fully. Use /embed for any future inspection.

stack.document_model: ProseMirror / TipTap. Evidence: data-node-view-wrapper x99, data-node-view-content x73, class 'react-renderer' x92, node-<type> class per PM node.
stack.icons: Font Awesome (svg-inline--fa x55 of 63 total SVGs)

card_layout_axis.meaning: Where the media sits relative to the text. This is the entire per-card design decision surface.

deck_composition.observation: Each card holds exactly ONE block type. 8/18 cards are smartLayout; 6/18 are a bare image. Text is poured into 3-cell smart layouts.

animation.mechanism: One-shot CSS transition on block entrance.
animation.keyframes_defined_on_page: All are third-party: fa-* (Font Awesome), loading/spinner, ProseMirror-cursor-blink, intercom-*. None belong to deck content.
animation.conclusion: No timeline. No scrub. No seek. No camera. Blocks fade+rise once when their card is entered.

present_mode.mounted_cards: current + next only; all other cards measure height 0
present_mode.transition_between_cards: transition: opacity 0.2s  <-- a 200ms crossfade. That is the entire slide-to-slide transition.

motion-present-mode-bg.verdict: A solid-colour letterbox div. Despite the class name there is NO moving background.

doc_mode.verdict: In doc mode cards are content-sized and stack vertically in a normal scroller (.doc-root, overflow-y auto). Same card list, different view. Continuous scroll is a VIEW MODE over a card array, not a canvas.

public_api_generation_surface.NO_VIDEO_EXPORT: exportAs has no mp4/video enum. Confirmed independently: Gamma has an open feature request to preserve animations in exports at all.
public_api_generation_surface.NO_STRUCTURE_CONTROL: There is no parameter anywhere in the generation API for diagram type, chart type, layout archetype, reveal steps, or animation. The whole surface is: how much text, which image style, which theme, how many cards.
